title: Towards Benchmarking Explainable Artificial Intelligence Methods
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It measured the perceived usefulness of various eXplainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) methods in explaining the decisions of an image classification model in the domains of animals and headgear.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion or faith, as its focus is on benchmarking XAI methods for image classification of mundane objects.
